1.o: تهرب "رايتشل" من حفل زفافها وتلتقي بالأصدقاء في أحد المقاهي، ويشعر "روس" بالاكتئاب بسبب طلاقه لكنه لا يزال معجبًا بـ "رايتشل".

2.t: The One with the Sonogram at the End
2.o: زوجة "روس" السابقة السحاقية حامل بطفله، ولا يعجبه اختيارها لاسم عائلة الطفل.

3.o: تمنح شركة مياه غازية سبعة آلاف دولار لـ "فيبي" لأنها عثرت على إصبع إبهام مقطوع في علبة مياه غازية.

4.o: يُحضر رجل التوصيل بيتزا عن طريق الخطأ للفتيات والتي كان من المفترض أن تصل إلى "جورج ستيفانوبولوس" الساكن في الجهة المقابلة لمسكنهن.

5.t: The One with the East German Laundry Detergent
5.ar: حلقة منظف الغسيل من ألمانيا الشرقية
5.o: يساعد "روس" "رايتشل" في غسل الملابس ويعتبر هذه الأمسية أول موعد غرامي بينهما، كما يطلب "جوي" من "مونيكا" التظاهر بأنها حبيبته الجديدة.

6.o: يحصل "جوي" على فرصته الكبرى في عالم السينما عندما يتمّ الاستعانة به ليكون بديلًا للمثل "آل باتشينو".

7.o: خلال انقطاع تام للكهرباء في المدينة، يحاول "روس" إخبار"رايتشل" أنه يكنّ لها إعجابًا.

8.t: The One Where Nana Dies Twice
8.o: تنعي "مونيكا" و "روس" موت جدتهما، بينما يتساءل "تشاندلر" عن ميوله الجنسية.

9.t: The One Where Underdog Gets Away
9.o: يحترق أول عشاء عيد شكر تُعدّه "مونيكا" للرفاق عندما يهرعون جميعًا إلى سطح المنزل لمشاهدة بالون "أندردوغ" الهارب من الموكب.

10.o: يتفق الرفاق على الاحتفال بليلة رأس السنة دون مواعدات لكنهم يخرقون هذا الاتفاق، ويتشارك "روس" الوحيد في غرفته مع قرد يُسمى "مارسيل".

11.o: عندما تزور والدة "تشاندلر"، كاتبة الروايات الرومانسية، مدينة نيويورك، يلمحها "جوي" تقبّل "روس".

12.t: The One with the Dozen Lasagnas
12.ar: حلقة الاثني عشر طبقًا من اللازانيا
12.o: تعطي "مونيكا" "باولو" بعضًا من اللازانيا التي أعدتها لعمتها، التي لا تريد تناولها بعد الآن لأنها تحتوي على اللحم.

13.o: يرى "تشاندلر" بالصدفة "رايتشل" تتجول عارية الصدر بعد الاستحمام، لذا تحاول "رايتشل" تصفية الحسابات بينهما.

14.t: The One with the Candy Hearts
14.o: يدبّر "جوي" موعدًا رومانسيًا بين "تشاندلر" و "جانيس" ويقابل "روس" "كارول" و "سوزان" بالصدفة في موعد غرامي في عيد الحب.

15.t: The One with the Stoned Guy
15.o: تُعد "مونيكا" وجبة طعام ليتذوقها صاحب مطعم يبحث عن طاهٍ جديد... لكنه ثمل لسوء حظها.

16.o: يقع "جوي" في حب شقيقة "فيبي" التوأم مما يشعر الأخيرة بالتجاهل، ويذهب "روس" لحضور صفوف "لاماز" بصحبة "كارول" و "سوزان".

17.o: عندما يتعرض كاحلها للالتواء ولا تتمتع بأي تأمين صحي، تقنع "رايتشل" "مونيكا" بانتحال هويتها كي تستفيد من تأمين "مونيكا" الصحي.

18.t: The One with All the Poker
18.o: تذهب "رايتشل" لمقابلة وظيفية كمساعد مشترٍ في متاجر "ساكس فيفث أفينيو"، وتواجه الفتيات الشباب في لعبة بوكر جدّية.

19.t: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
19.o: يبحث الرفاق عن القرد "مارسيل" الذي هرب من شقة "رايتشل" أثناء رعايتها له.

20.t: The One with the Evil Orthodontist
20.o: تبدأ "رايتشل" و "باري" المواعدة مجددًا على الرغم من خِطبته لـ "ميندي" التي تريد أن تصبح "رايتشل" إشبينتها يوم زفافها.

21.t: The One with the Fake Monica
21.o: عندما تُسرق بطاقة "مونيكا" الائتمانية، تقرر الإمساك باللص.

22.t: The One with the Ick Factor
22.o: بعد فقدانه لعذريتة برفقتها، يكشف حبيب "مونيكا" حقيقة أنه طالب في سنته الأخيرة من المرحلة الثانوية، وتعمل "فيبي" كسكرتيرة مؤقتة لـ "تشاندلر".

23.o: تنتاب "كارول" آلام المخاض، بينما يعلق كل من "روس" و "فيبي" و "سوزان" في إحدى الخزانات.

24.t: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
24.o: أثناء حفل عيد ميلاد "رايتشل"، يكشِف "تشاندلر" عن دون قصد عن أن "روس" مُغرم بها.

1.t: The One with Ross's New Girlfriend
1.o: تنتظر "رايتشل" "روس" في المطار غير مدركة أنه عائد من الصين بصحبة حبيبته الجديدة "جولي"، وتقصّ "فيبي" شعر "مونيكا" بشكلٍ سيئ للغاية.

2.t: The One with the Breast Milk
2.o: لا يوافق الرجال على فكرة حليب ثدي "كارول" بينما تتضايق "رايتشل" من تنامي الصداقة بين "مونيكا" و "جولي".

3.o: يموت السيد "هيكلز" ويترك ممتلكاته لـ "مونيكا" و "رايتشل" ويكتشف "تشاندلر" أن هناك تشابهًا غريبًا بينه وبين الرجل الراحل غريب الأطوار.

4.o: تتزوج "فيبي" من راقص على الجليد كندي مثلي لمساعدته في الحصول على بطاقة الإقامة في الولايات المتحدة.

5.t: The One with Five Steaks and an Eggplant
5.o: تؤدي قضايا الدخل للتفرقة بين الأصدقاء؛ فـ "روس" و "تشاندلر" و "مونيكا" يملكون المال، و "فيبي" و "رايتشل" و "جوي" لا يملكون مالًا.

6.t: The One with the Baby on the Bus
6.o: يفقد "تشاندلر" و "جوي" ابن "روس" أثناء تفحصهما للنساء في الحافلة.

7.t: The One Where Ross Finds Out
7.o: تتصل "رايتشل" وهي ثملة بـ "روس" وتخبره بمشاعرها تجاهه على جهاز الردّ الآلي، وبات يتعين على "روس" الآن الاختيار بينها وبين "جولي".

8.o: يساعد "تشاندلر" و "جوي" "روس" في قرار الاختيار بين "رايتشل" و "جولي" عبر إعداد قائمة تسرد محاسن ومساوئ كل منهما.

9.o: في هذه الحلقة الخاصة بعيد الميلاد، تحاول "فيبي" البحث عن والدها الحقيقي.

10.o: تواعد "رايتشل" شخصًا يدعى "راس" وهي غافلة عن التشابه الغريب بينه وبين "روس".

11.t: The One with the Lesbian Wedding
11.o: تتولى "مونيكا" مسؤولية إعداد الطعام لحفل زفاف زوجة "روس" السابقة وعشيقتها المثلية، بينما تكتشف "رايتشل" أن والديها سينهيان زواجهما.

12.t: The One After the Super Bowl (1)
12.o: يسافر "روس" إلى "سان دييجو" لزيارة قرده "مارسيل"، ويتتبّع "جوي" أحد المعجبين بالمسلسل النهاري الذي يقوم ببطولته في أول أجزاء الحلقة.

13.t: The One After the Super Bowl (2)
13.o: تتنافس "رايتشل" و "مونيكا" على إعجاب "جون-كلود فان دام"، بينما يذهب "روس" و "مارسيل" في جولة عبر المدينة في الجزء الثاني من الحلقة.

14.t: The One with the Prom Video
14.o: يكشِف فيديو حفل تخرج "مونيكا" و "رايتشل" حجم "مونيكا" السابق، وأنف "رايتشل" السابق، وكيف كانت مشاعر "روس" نحو "رايتشل" دائمًا.

15.t: The One Where Ross and Rachel... You Know
15.o: تأتي اللحظة التي يمارس فيها "روس" و "رايتشل" الحب، وتُعجب "مونيكا" بأحد أصدقاء والديها الذي تتولى مسؤولية تزويد إحدى حفلاته بالطعام.

16.t: The One Where Joey Moves Out
16.o: يترك "جوي" المنزل بعد شجاره مع "تشاندلر"، بينما يكتشف والد "مونيكا" أنها تواعد أعز أصدقائه.

17.t: The One Where Eddie Moves In
17.o: يفكر "جوي" في العودة إلى السكن مع "تشاندلر"، لكن "تشاندلر" لديه زميل جديد في السكن.

18.t: The One Where Dr. Ramoray Dies
18.o: يتمّ الإلقاء بالشخصية التي يؤديها "جوي" في مسلسله النهاري في بئر المصعد وذلك بعد تفاخره بأنه يكتب حواراته بنفسه.

19.t: The One Where Eddie Won't Go
19.o: يطلب "تشاندلر" من رفيقه في السكن غريب الأطوار "إدي" الرحيل... وهو ما يرفضه الأخير.

20.t: The One Where Old Yeller Dies
20.o: تتحطّم نظرة "فيبي" للعالم عندما تكتشف النهاية الحقيقية لفيلم "Old Yeller".

21.o: يطرد متنمّران "تشاندلر" و "روس" من مقهي "سنترال بيرك"، بينما تلتقي "فيبي" بشقيق لم تكن تعرف بوجوده من قبل.

22.t: The One with the Two Parties
22.o: تتعقد الأمور عندما يظهر والدا "رايتشل" المبتعديّن عنها في حفل مفاجئ خطّط بقية الرفاق لإقامته لها.

23.t: The One with the Chicken Pox
23.o: تُصاب "فيبي" بالجدري من الطفل الرضيع في الوقت الذي يرجع فيه حبيبها السابق من القوات البحرية لقضاء إجازة.

24.t: The One with Barry and Mindy's Wedding
24.o: توافق "رايتشل" على أن تكون إشبينة في حفل زفاف خطيبها السابق.

1.t: The One with the Princess Leia Fantasy
1.ar: حلقة فكرة الأميرة ليا الخيالية المثيرة
1.o: يفصح "روس" لـ "رايتشل" عن حلم يقظة يتضمن شخصية معينة من سلسلة أفلام "Star Wars".

2.t: The One Where No One's Ready
2.o: في سباق مع الزمن، يحاول "روس" إقناع رفاقه بالاستعداد وارتداء الملابس الرسمية لحفل خيري في المتحف.

3.o: بعد قطع علاقتها بـ "ريتشارد"، تستغل "مونيكا" وقت فراغها في صنع المربى، وتفكر في الحمل من خلال بنك الحيوانات المنوية.

4.t: The One with the Metaphorical Tunnel
4.o: يفزع "روس" عندما يرى ابنه بصحبة دمية "باربي"، وتتظاهر "فيبي" بأنها وكيلة "جوي" وتحصل له على أدوار جيدة.

5.o: يقوم أخو "فيبي" غير الشقيق بزيارتها، ويجدان مشكلة في خلق روابط بينهما.

6.o: عندما تسأل "جانيس" الرفاق إذا كانوا قد مارسوا الحب سويًا، يعود الأصدقاء بالذاكرة إلى ثلاث سنوات مضت.

7.t: The One with the Race Car Bed
7.o: تشتري "مونيكا" سريرًا جديدًا من زوج "جانيس" الذي سينفصل عنها عمّا قريب، لكنها تحصل على سرير آخر غير الذي أرادته.

8.t: The One with the Giant Poking Device
8.o: يضبط "جوي" و "مونيكا" "جانيس" تقبّل زوجها السابق.

9.o: يلعب الرفاق كرة القدم باللمس في عيد الشكر.

10.o: تترك "رايتشل" وظيفتها بعد أن يخبرها "غانثر" بأنها تحتاج إلى أن تتدرب من جديد.

11.t: The One Where Chandler Can't Remember Which Sister
11.ar: حلقة تشاندلر لا يتذكر أية شقيقة
11.o: يعبث "تشاندلر" وهو ثمل مع إحدى شقيقات "جوي"... لكنه لا يستطيع تذكر أي واحدة منهن.

12.t: The One with All the Jealousy
12.o: يشعر "روس" بالغيرة عندما يظن أنه ضبط زميل "رايتشل" الجديد في العمل وهو يغازلها.

13.t: The One Where Monica and Richard Are Just Friends
13.o: تخضع قوة إرادة "مونيكا" للاختبار عندما تقابل "ريتشارد" بالصدفة في متجر لشرائط الفيديو.

14.o: تجتمع "فيبي" مجددًا مع شريكتها السابقة في الغناء، بينما تؤثّر وظيفة "رايتشل" الجديدة على علاقتها بـ "روس" سلبًا.

15.t: The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break
15.ar: حلقة روس ورايتشل يأخذان فترة للراحة
15.o: يبحث "روس" عن المواساة في إحدى الحفلات بعد شجار عنيف مع "رايتشل" وينتهي به المطاف في أحضان امرأة أخرى.

16.t: The One with the Morning After
16.o: عندما تكتشف "رايتشل" أن "روس" مارس الحب مع "كلوي"، تقرر الانفصال عنه.

17.t: The One Without the Ski Trip
17.o: يزور "روس" الشاعر بالوحدة "كارول" عندما تذهب "رايتشل" في رحلة تزلج مع بعض الأصدقاء.

18.t: The One with the Hypnosis Tape
18.o: تنزعج "فيبي" عندما تعرف أن شقيقها يريد الزواج من سيدة تبلغ ضعف عمره، ويدفع شريط تنويم مغناطيسي "تشاندلر" إلى التصرف كأنثى.

19.t: The One with the Tiny T-Shirt
19.o: تخرج "رايتشل" في أول موعد رومانسي لها منذ انفصالها عن "روس"، وتواعد "مونيكا" "بيت" رغم أنها لا تشعر بالانجذاب تجاهه.

20.o: يظن "جوي" أنه عثر على حبه الحقيقي، وتواعد رئيسة "رايتشل" في العمل "تشاندلر" مما يخلق مشكلة كبرى لـ "رايتشل"، وترث "مونيكا" بيت دمية.

21.t: The One with the Chick and the Duck
21.o: حين يشتري "بيت" مطعمًا، يتحتّم على "مونيكا" أن تقرر ما إذا كانت ستقبل بعرض العمل هناك، بينما يتبنّى "تشاندلر" و "جوي" بطة ودجاجة.

22.o: يعتقد "روس" أن رفيق "رايتشل" مجنون، ويقع "جوي" في حب "كيت"، لكن عندما يُعرض عليها وظيفة في لوس أنجلوس، تقبل بها فورًا.

23.ar: حلقة شيء ما على جسد روس
23.o: يلاحظ "روس" نموّ شيء غريب على أردافه، ويتعيّن على "فيبي" الاختيار بين رجلين، أما حبيب "مونيكا" فيُفاجئها بعدم عرضه الزواج عليها.

24.t: The One with the Ultimate Fighting Champion
24.o: تُصعق "مونيكا" حين تعلم أن "بيت" يخطط للمشاركة في مباراة قتالية، وتدبر "فيبي" موعدًا غراميًا بين "روس" وامرأة اعتادت أن تكون صلعاء.

25.o: يذهب الرفاق إلى الشاطئ وتلتقي "فيبي" بصديق لعائلتها مرتبط بماضي العائلة، بينما يكتشف "روس" أن "رايتشل" ما زالت تحبه.

1.t: The One Where No One Proposes
1.o: Following Rachel's acceptance of Joey's accidental proposal, confusion reigns as Rachel wonders whether it was the right thing to do and Phoebe can't seem to mind her own business. Finally, Rachel, Ross and Joey get together and figure out that no one was actually going to propose. Meanwhile, Mr. Geller walks in on Monica and Chandler having sex in a closet.

2.o: Chandler, having trouble getting enough sleep at home, falls asleep in a meeting and accidentally agrees to run his company's Tulsa office. Emma won't stop crying after Rachel interrupts her nap; Monica and Phoebe try to help get her back to sleep. Meanwhile, Ross is still mad at Joey, and breaks his finger trying to punch him.

3.o: Rachel's pediatrician drops her as a client because she calls him incessantly to ask about any insignificant issue concerning Emma, so now she must find a new one, which puts Ross in an awkward situation. Meanwhile, Joey arranges a blind date for Phoebe. Also, as Chandler and Monica are preparing to leave for Tulsa, Monica receives a job offer from a prestige restaurant in Manhattan.

4.o: After Phoebe has a talk with Ross, it prompts her to realize that she's never had a long term relationship. Monica makes a startling discovery while visiting Chandler in Tulsa. Also, Joey goes on a date with an attractive woman and discovers that her apartment seems really familiar, although he doesn't remember sleeping with her before.

5.t: The One with Phoebe's Birthday Dinner
5.o: The friends are looking forward to getting together and celebrating Phoebe's birthday. However, on the day of the party, Ross struggles to convince Rachel to leave Emma with Mrs. Geller babysitting, and Monica and Chandler get into an argument, after Monica discovers that he's been smoking. All of this causes them to be incredibly late, leaving Phoebe and Joey alone at a restaurant with a table for six.

6.t: The One with the Male Nanny
6.o: Ross and Rachel hire a nanny for Emma named Sandy and things seem to be going great. However, Ross is uncomfortable having a male nanny. Meanwhile, Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her new job is the funniest guy she's ever met. Also, after Phoebe and Mike  decide to take their relationship to a new level and exchange apartment keys, Phoebe gets a surprise visit from her ex-boyfriend David.

7.t: The One with Ross's Inappropriate Song
7.o: Ross finds a way to make Emma laugh - singing Sir Mix-A-Lot's "Baby Got Back." Needless to say, Rachel isn't as amused, once she finds out. Meanwhile, Phoebe meets Mike's parents and tries her best to leave a good impression. Also, while viewing Richard's old apartment, Joey and Chandler discover a video tape with Monica's name on it, which causes Chandler to freak out, since he thinks it's a sex tape.

8.t: The One with Rachel's Other Sister
8.o: Rachel's sister Amy tags along for Thanksgiving at Monica's place, because her (married) boyfriend cancels their plans. While watching the parade, Joey realizes that he forgot to show up for the Days of Our Lives cast float, and he asks Phoebe's help to come up with a believable lie. The dinner goes fairly well, however, Monica constantly obsesses about anybody damaging her best china. To make matters worse, Amy comes up with a crazy scenario involving Emma, which sparks a massive argument among the gang.

9.t: The One with Rachel's Phone Number
9.o: Joey becomes convinced that Monica is having an affair, after Chandler sneaks back into town without him knowing, in order to have some alone time with his wife. Meanwhile, Rachel and Phoebe have a girls night out, and Rachel gives her phone number to a guy they meet at a bar. Also, Ross and Mike try to hang out together but it doesn't go very well, since they can't find a common interest to talk about.

10.t: The One with Christmas in Tulsa
10.o: Everyone in the gang gets a little upset when Chandler announces that he'll be spending Christmas and New Year's Eve in Tulsa because of work. To make matters worse, Monica gets quite jealous when she finds out that one of Chandler's co-workers is a former Miss Oklahoma runner-up. After doing some retrospection, Chandler decides to quit his job.

11.t: The One Where Rachel Goes Back to Work
11.o: Chandler starts looking for a job and is anxious about having a baby with Monica while uncertain about his career prospects. Meanwhile, Rachel visits work and finds out that during her leave, a guy named Gavin has been temporarily assigned to take care of her job. She starts to feel insecure about her job position and decides to come back from her leave early. Also, Phoebe works as an extra on Joey's TV show and brings even more drama to the set.

12.o: Gavin gives Rachel a very interesting birthday gift while Ross begs Joey to stay away from Emma's hot new nanny. Meanwhile, Mike meets and then accidentally murders Phoebe's unusual pet.

13.o: A night at Mike's piano bar gives Monica a very showy moment in the spotlight. Ross struggles to move on after witnessing Gavin and Rachel kiss. Meanwhile, Chandler employs his secret skill to repair Joey's botched eyebrow-waxing job.

14.t: The One with the Blind Dates
14.o: Phoebe and Joey purposely set Ross and Rachel up on bad dates in the hopes they'll get back together. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler babysit Emma, and aren't being as responsible as they should be.

15.o: Joey endures a draining audition at the hands of a pompous actor-director. Ross and Phoebe discover a secret link after being mugged together on the street. Chandler's advertising internship gets off to an impressive start.

16.t: The One with the Boob Job
16.o: While reviewing their monthly expenses, Monica and Chandler discover that their situation is less than stellar. This results in Monica asking Joey to lend her some money without telling Chandler. When Chandler eventually finds out, Joey comes up with a lie that Monica needs the money for breast enhancement procedure. Meanwhile, Phoebe gets really excited as she and Mike decide to move in together, but her excitement quickly dissipates once she discovers that Mike doesn't see himself getting married ever again. Also, Rachel's attempt to baby-proof the apartment tampers with a frustrated Joey's

17.t: The One with the Memorial Service
17.o: Chandler's jokey entry on his and Ross's college website leads to a faux burial service for the allegedly dead and obviously unpopular Gellar. Meanwhile, Joey is unwilling to give his favorite stuffed animal, Hugsy, to Emma. And Phoebe asks Monica to help her avoid a post-breakup tryst with Mike.

18.o: Monica leads the gang, except for a scoffing Ross, to purchase a bunch of lottery tickets for the multi-million-dollar powerball jackpot. However, as they gleefully plot about how they will spend the fortune if they win, they start bickering among themselves until Phoebe takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Chandler frets as he waits for a phone call about a hiring job position and Rachel thinks baby Emma is close to saying her first words.

19.o: After visiting the set of "Days of Our Lives", Rachel catches herself dreaming about a romantic encounter with Joey. Meanwhile, Chandler buys a non-refundable weekend getaway for himself and Monica, but when she can't get time off at work, Ross joins him. Also, Phoebe takes advantage of Monica's restaurant clientele.

20.t: The One with the Soap Opera Party
20.o: Joey secretly throws a party on the roof of his building for the "Days of Our Lives" cast and he reluctantly invites the rest of the gang, once they discover his plans. Meanwhile, Ross meets a new colleague, Charlie, and is instantly attracted to her, however, he feels intimidated once he learns about her accomplished ex-boyfriends. Also, everyone forgets to tell Chandler about the change of plans and he gets stuck at a theater play by himself.

21.t: The One with the Fertility Test
21.o: Joey comes to Ross for advice on dating Charlie, since they don't share much of the same interests. Meanwhile, Chandler and Monica bump into Janice at a fertility clinic. Also, Rachel has a gift certificate for a massage at a fancy massage place which Phoebe doesn't want her to use, since she doesn't approve of big corporations.

22.o: Rachel and Phoebe take Joey's girlfriend Charlie shopping, where she overhears the two of them gossiping about Joey. Meanwhile, Ross gives a presentation to a fellow professor in the hopes of getting the role of keynote speaker at the paleontology convention in Barbados. Also, Monica and Chandler consider alternate pregnancy options making some people really uncomfortable in the process.

23.o: The gang heads down to Barbados for the paleontology conference. While Ross and Charlie are excited about attending multiple seminars, the rest of the gang just want to enjoy their time on the beach but the rainy weather prevents them from doing so. Things, however, are far from boring - Phoebe discovers that she still has feelings for Mike even though she enjoys spending time with David, Rachel feels lonely and struggles to keep her feelings about Joey to herself, and Chandler is amused by Monica's hair.

1.t: The One After Joey and Rachel Kiss
1.o: After leaving Barbados, Joey and Ross both attempt to come clean to each other that they're dating Rachel and Charlie, however, various obstacles constantly get in their way. Meanwhile, Monica gets a new haircut much to Chandler's dismay and Phoebe finds out that Mike has another girlfriend.

2.t: The One Where Ross Is Fine
2.o: After Ross finds out about Joey and Rachel's relationship, he invites Rachel, Joey and Charlie to a dinner party at his apartment, which ends up being really uncomfortable for everyone involved. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler are overwhelmed by various adoption options and Phoebe suggests talking to a couple that has gone through the process. Unfortunately things go sideways when Chandler can't keep his big mouth shut. Also, Phoebe is visited by her brother, Frank Jr., who is desperate because he can no longer cope with his precocious triplets.

3.o: Ross goes to a spray-on tanning salon but fails to follow the 'simple' instructions. Meanwhile, Joey and Rachel struggle to make the transition from friends to lovers. Also, Monica and Phoebe try to avoid an annoying woman that used to live in their building.

4.o: On Emma's first birthday, Ross and Rachel convince everyone to delay their plans so they can attend her party, however plans go awry when Emma's birthday cake is revealed.

5.t: The One Where Rachel's Sister Babysits
5.o: To help her younger sister, Amy, become a more responsible person, Rachel overrides Ross' strong protests and allows Amy to baby-sit Emma but soon regrets that decision. Meanwhile, Joey volunteers to write a recommendation letter for Monica and Chandler's adoption agency, however, he's concerned about not sounding smart. Also, Phoebe unknowingly thwarts Mike's "anniversary" surprise for her.

6.o: Ross has a chance to be selected by Dr. Benjamin Hobart for an esteemed paleontology grant. Unfortunately, Hobart happens to be Charlie's obsessed ex-boyfriend. Meanwhile, Phoebe tries to give a hideous painting she created to an extremely reluctant Monica and Rachel. Also, Joey is offended when Chandler lies about viewing Joey's bizarre audition tape reel.

7.t: The One with the Home Study
7.o: Monica and Chandler nervously prepare for a visit from an adoption worker who will decide if they would be suitable parents. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Mike keep changing their minds about donating their wedding money to a children's charity. And Ross tries to help Rachel overcome her fear of swing sets so that baby Emma can enjoy the playground.

8.t: The One with the Late Thanksgiving
8.o: Joey, Ross, Rachel and Phoebe convince Monica and Chandler to host a Thanksgiving dinner, however the four of them end up arriving an hour late as the boys decide to go to Rangers game, while the girls take Emma to a baby beauty pageant. This enrages Monica and she refuses to let the famished guests into her and Chandler's apartment which causes even bigger problems.

9.t: The One with the Birth Mother
9.o: Nervous and excited, Monica and Chandler travel to Ohio to meet a young pregnant woman, Erica Simmons, who is considering allowing them to adopt her child when it's born. Upon meeting her they discover that due to a mix-up at the adoption agency, Erica thinks that Monica is a reverend and Chandler is a doctor. Meanwhile, Joey dates Phoebe's friend but annoys her with his territorial eating habits. Also Rachel picks out an outfit for Ross to wear on a date but due to a mix up he ends up in an awkward position.

10.t: The One Where Chandler Gets Caught
10.o: After Phoebe and Rachel catch Chandler getting into a car with an unknown blonde woman, they follow them to the suburbs. Fearing that Chandler is cheating on Monica, they inform her and learn that the woman is a real estate agent. The pair has been secretly shopping for houses and struggling with how to tell their best friends about their plans. Together the friends reminisce about their good times in the apartment.

11.t: The One Where the Stripper Cries
11.o: Joey is a celebrity contestant on "The $100,000 Pyramid," with its actual host, Donny Osmond. Meanwhile, Phoebe's bachelorette party features a rather unexpected surprise when the stripper shows up. Also, Chandler and Ross attend a college reunion and flash back to 1987 to reflect on a pact they made when they were in college.

12.o: As the big day approaches, Phoebe's wedding planner, Monica, makes everyone around her crazy because according to her - every little thing needs to happen around schedule. This doesn't sit well with Phoebe and she fires her. Unfortunately, on the wedding day New York is hit with the worst snowstorm its seen in 20 years, forcing plans to change. As a substitute for Phoebe's incarcerated father, Joey takes his role much too seriously. Meanwhile, Chandler and Ross discover that neither of them has a part in the wedding; however, after one of Mike's groomsmen is unable to attend, they compete for

13.t: The One Where Joey Speaks French
13.o: Joey implores Francophile Phoebe to teach him French before an important audition, but she quickly becomes exasperated. Meanwhile, surrogate mom Erica is visiting town and tells the Bings that the baby's father may be a shovel killer. Also, Ross and Rachel grow closer after her sarcastic father, Dr. Green, suffers a heart attack.

14.o: Monica and Chandler visit their potential new house and bring Joey along, who's still upset about them moving, so he's determined to change their minds. Meanwhile, Phoebe learns that she can legally change her name to whatever she wants, so she considers something more exotic. Also, Ross gets tenure at his job, while Rachel's unfortunate job interview actually leads her to some new career opportunities.

15.o: After Rachel makes a startling announcement about her possibly accepting a new job offer in Paris, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back at Ralph Lauren. Joey is so flustered by all of the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent Estelle. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler check out the house for sale next door to their new suburban home and make a stunning discovery.

16.t: The One with Rachel's Going Away Party
16.o: Extremely pregnant Erica visits Monica and Chandler just as they are preparing to move to their new house in the suburbs. At the same time Rachel has packed and ready for her move to Paris, so on her last night in New York the gang hosts a farewell party for her. She says goodbye to each of her friends individually, except for Ross and he's offended. However, before the night is over, there will be more surprises.

17.o:
Erica goes into labor and the new parents, Monica and Chandler, get a bit more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Joey gets them a housewarming gift - Chick Jr. and Duck Jr., who unfortunately get trapped inside the foosball table. Also, after their night together, Ross realizes that he's still in love with Rachel and doesn't want her to leave. Other friends convince him to go after her and Phoebe races Ross to the airport in a bid to stop Rachel from leaving for Paris.

The six friends prepare to say goodbye and embark on the next chapters of their lives.

1.o: As the remote Arctic town struggles with government cuts and a missing sheriff, a chilling discovery proves that the horror isn't over for the locals.

2.o: Governor Odegard is presented with devastating news as Sheriff Dan struggles for his life, and a new threat makes its presence known.

3.o: Natalie and Vincent head out into the wilderness and the police track down their suspect, but a dark turn of events leads them to question everything.

4.o: Eric struggles to keep control as the body count increases. Meanwhile, Natalie and Vincent's field trip descends into chaos.

5.o: A disturbing challenge is issued. Michael finds a glimmer of hope for Freya, while Vincent's trust in Natalie is shattered.

6.o: Dr Khatri attempts to cover her tracks when Michael presents the scientists with a miracle. Dan and Elena relive their trauma.

7.o: Michael finds something unexpected on the tundra, and Dan is confronted with what he is becoming, just as a heartbreaking discovery changes the town forever.

8.o: As the town attempts to come to terms with the recent tragedy, Petra and Ingrid seek the truth. Meanwhile, Dr Khatri moves a step closer to achieving her goal.

9.o: Dan faces his toughest battle yet as someone makes the ultimate sacrifice for the greater good, while Michael and Ingrid venture out in search of justice.

10.o: The people of Fortitude take matters into their own hands. Dan seeks his own vengeance, but is there still a demon among the herd?

1.o: Oslo sends two new officers to attempt to make some sense of the anarchy in Fortitude. Dan Anderssen continues his descent into madness, bringing him face to face with a grief-stricken Michael Lennox.

2.o: A survivor of the deadly parasite makes a connection with Michael, but things take a violent turn. Dan continues to lose his grip on reality.

3.o: Michael hunts for the place he was held captive, and makes a shocking discovery. Annie Burgess arrives in Fortitude looking for answers.

4.o: Michael sacrifices everything for a possible future with Elsa. As his violent deeds catch up with him, Dan realises he will never leave Fortitude.

1.o: Secret Service agents Lattimer and Bering are "rewarded" with a transfer to the top-secret Warehouse 13. They meet Artie Nielsen, the caretaker of the mysterious warehouse, who tells them about their new job. The agents are responsible for the collection of every supernatural and unexplained item that the U.S. Government has ever collected. For their first assignment, they are sent to Iowa to investigate a possible artifact belonging to a college student who went berserk and assaulted his girlfriend while chanting an Italian incantation.

2.o: Pete and Myka are after a team of bank robbers who have a distinctive weapon. Meanwhile, Artie examines the security breach at the warehouse.

3.o: Pete and Myka are sent to investigate a town where the inhabitants' minds are being altered making them act as they please. Meanwhile, Artie is confused by the energy flows going on in the warehouse.

4.o: A woman kidnaps Artie and insists that he help her recover her brother... who was lost in an artifact-related experiment 12 years ago.

5.o: The theft of a sculpture leads Myka and Pete to a sacred Indian cave holding an ancient secret of creation... and destruction.

6.o: Pete and Myka take on a previous agent's assignment after the man's corpse turns up in the basement of a St. Louis police station.

7.o: Pete and Myka return to Washington to intercept a samurai sword that is to be presented to the president, and they discover a competitor for items that belong to the warehouse.

8.o: Pete and Myka go to Las Vegas to fetch an artifact that is helping a couple of gamblers, but the mission goes awry when Myka becomes trapped in a famous author's mirror.

9.o: Pete and Myka visit a Florida prison to probe a spate of unexplained suicides. Meanwhile, Claudia changes a light bulb with the help of an artifact.

10.o: Artie gets questioned by the Regents and Mrs. Frederic. Meanwhile, Pete, Myka and Claudia become trapped inside Warehouse 13, where a dangerous predicament unfolds.

11.o: After receiving word that her father is dying, Myka travels home to see her parents.

12.o: The team discovers that MacPherson is auctioning artifacts he has siphoned from the Warehouse shelves.

1.o: In the season two premiere, we pick up right where we left off. MacPherson has blown Artie to smithereens, and disappeared. Is Leena really a traitor? Where has Claudia gone? How will Pete, Myka and the Warehouse fare without Artie? What other havoc did MacPherson wreak when he was alone in the Warehouse? And is there yet a new villain on the horizon?

2.o: A super-powered vigilante is at large in Detroit, and the agents try to track down the person responsible. Meanwhile, things between Leena and Claudia are still tense, and Artie is haunted by the spirit of his dead friend.

3.o: When an artifact meant for the Warehouse turns up in the small town next door, the team finds themselves in the middle of a B-movie meltdown complete with cowboys, gladiators, sci-fi robots and beach storming marines. Their only chance of survival rests with the man who invented television, Philo T. Farnsworth.

4.o: When young super models rapidly age 50 years overnight, Pete and Myka go undercover in the glam world of high fashion to discover who – and what – is behind the transformations.

5.o: Douglas Fargo of Eureka's Global Dynamics is sent to Warehouse 13 to help update its aging computer system. This triggers a seemingly sentient computer virus that sends the Warehouse into lockdown and traps the team inside.

6.o: Mrs. Frederick secretly recruits Pete to find a mole within the organization who is buying artifacts. However, when the mole finds out, they go after those closest to Pete.

7.o: Claudia has just been given her first assignment, but when it involves a real human torch and H.G. Wells could it be too much for her to handle? Not to mention an appearance by an old love of Artie's

8.o: The agents hope to spend a weekend relaxing until an artifact gets in the way.

9.o: Someone is using Artie's artifacts to commit a series of murders.

10.o: Pete and Myka use H.G. Wells's time machine to travel back to 1961.

11.o: When Mrs. Frederic is stricken ill, the agents must search for a cure before it's too late. Their quest takes them to Egypt and the long-lost Warehouse 2.

12.o: The team tries to track down their rogue member, and discover the artifact they have is unexpectedly powerful. Meanwhile, Claudia wonders about her future with the Warehouse team and Pete must choose between Kelly and the mission.

13.o: As the Warehouse team prepares to celebrate the holidays in snowy South Dakota, Pete and Myka are called upon to hunt down a malevolent Santa Claus. Meanwhile, in time for Hanukkah, Artie and his estranged father, Isadore Weisfelt reunite after 30 years.

1.o: When we last left agents Myka Bering and Pete Lattimer at the conclusion of season 2, Myka had decided to leave the top secret team with little to no warning. As season 3 begins, Artie fills Myka's shoes with 'The New Guy,' which also happens to be the name of the season premiere episode.

2.o: While Pete and Myka go after someone using an artifact to induce Alzheimer's, Claudia goes on her first case as a full agent with Steve to track down Typhoid Mary's knife.

3.o: While Artie and Claudia meet with Vanessa Calder and Hugo Miller to investigate a computer virus that transforms people into clay, Myka and Pete wake up naked in bed and try to find a missing Steve.

4.o: Pete's ex-wife arrives in town to remarry, but an artifact may derail the wedding. Steve and Claudia visit a Civil War reenactment in search of an artifact

5.o: When a series of mysterious disintegration deaths occur in Pittsburgh, the team discovers that the artifact responsible, Joshua's Horn, has ties to Helena's time as an agent in 1893.

6.o: Pete, Claudia, and Myka are called in to help Fargo, who is trapped in a virtual reality swords & sorcery game. Meanwhile, Artie and Steve are summoned to New York to recover an artifact... by FBI agent Sally Stukowski.

7.o: While in Denver, Myka picks up the trail of the counterfeiter who killed her former partner, Sam Martino. Meanwhile, Artie, Claudia, and Steve interrogate a dog that witnessed the theft of an artifact.

8.o: Sally Stukowski and her partner make their move, attacking the Regents and using an artifact to trap them in a building and bring it down around them.

9.o: While Pete and his mother Jane try to determine the origins of their mysterious opponents, Myka and Claudia travel to Portland to stop a girl who can apparently vaporize anyone she hates with blasts of radiation.

10.o: Myka and Pete deal with a plague of zombies in Ithaca, while Claudia deals with a new romance, a prophecy of death, and a rejection from a friend.

11.o: As Sykes begins his end game, the agents discover that Helena is still alive... and teaching high school literature. Meanwhile, Jane reveals the full extent of her plan but one agent will lose their life carrying it out.

12.o: Pete and Myka race to stop Sykes from using his own cache of artifacts to destroy them and the Warehouse.

13.o: Pete Lattimer is hit in the head by an artifact and wakes up to a life where he was never born. Pete must hunt down and persuade the Warehouse team (none of whom recognize him) to go on this life or death mission with him to vanquish a long dead nemesis from the past to get everyone’s lives back.

1.o: In the aftermath of the warehouse's destruction, the Warehouse team races against the clock to find a way to undo time itself and put right what went wrong. However, Artie finds himself facing a difficult decision when he is warned that saving the warehouse will unleash an even greater evil.

2.o: While Claudia tries to help a friend and gets unexpected help, Pete and Myka investigate an artifact that causes crowds to see certain individuals as monsters... and attack them.

3.o: A cache of Walter Skyes' stolen artifacts turn up and all six agents go into the field to recover them. Artie unexpectedly reveals his secret to Leena, while Steve begins to realize the downside of the metronome that brought him back to life.

4.o: While Pete and Claudia help Hugo Miller track down a bag of marbles at a boy's academy, Myka and Steve travel to New Orleans on the trail of another artifact while Artie meets with Brother Adrian.

5.o: While Pete and Myka go to Toronto to investigate an invulnerable hockey player, Steve helps Artie track down stolen artifacts while Claudia meets with Mrs. Fredericks to discuss her future as a warehouse guardian.

6.o: The Brotherhood continues its assault on Artie's life, targeting someone close to him with Alice Liddell, the imprisoned spirit within the Dodgson Mirror. Meanwhile, Claudia learns of the connection between her and Steven.

7.o: While Pete and Myka investigate a series of artifact-related growth spurts, Artie reluctantly takes Steve and Claudia with him to track down Brother Adrian before he can steal more artifacts from the warehouse.

8.o: While Pete and Myka travel to West Virginia to investigate a rust-like infection among steelworkers, Steven and Claudia go to Steven's home to find a way to break the metronome's hold on him. Meanwhile, Helena, Leena, and Mrs. Frederic confront Artie with their knowledge of what he has done.

9.o: Pete, Myka, and Claudia set off to rescue their loved ones when Brother Adrian sends them deadly artifacts. Meanwhile, Mrs. Frederic and Steve travel to Rome and learn Adrian's dark secret.

10.o: The team have no time to mourn a fallen comrade as they go after the person responsible, the nemesis that has been stalking Artie since he used Magellan's Astrolabe to save the world.

11.o: With the fate of the world in their hands, Pete and Myka's only hope of finding a cure to the Sweating Sickness is a drunken history professor. Meanwhile, Steven and Claudia enter Artie's subconscious in an attempt to bring him out of his coma before he fades away for good.

12.o: While Pete and Claudia travel to Oregon to look for an artifact used to kill enemies of the environmental movement, Artie deals with the repercussions of Leena's death.

13.o: A mishap with an artifact traps Pete and Myka in a fictional 1940s world where they have to solve a murder to escape... but someone doesn't want them to. Meanwhile, Claudia and Steven convince Artie to go along with them to investigate reports of stolen cars, and Artie starts taking dangerous risks.

14.o: While Pete and Myka travel to Las Vegas to investigate two deaths where the people inexplicably fell from great heights, Claudia and Steven investigate two jockeys in London who went into comas after winning their races. Meanwhile, Artie gets a visitor to the warehouse.

15.o: H.G. has created a new life for herself in Wisconsin, but calls in the agents when she comes up against an unidentified artifact. Meanwhile, Abigail joins the others on the floor of the warehouse to track down the source of mysterious tremors that threaten to destroy the building.

16.o: Pete, Myka, and Steven team up with a U.S. Marshal to track down two prisoners who used a lava-spewing artifact to escape prison. However, they discover that the Marshal is Steve's ex. Meanwhile, Artie and Claudia try to track down part of an artifact that is rendering Artie deaf...

17.o: Someone in a gated community is using an artifact to extract vengeance and Myka and Pete go to investigate. Meanwhile, Artie and Claudia help a teen suffering from dangerous visions, and Steven and Abigail clean up the warehouse.

18.o: The agents track down a cache of artifacts stolen from Warehouse 12 by the infamous Roaring Dan Seavey... and guarded by his ghost. Meanwhile, Charlotte Dupres makes her move with the help of her inside person.

19.t: All the Time in the World
19.o: Pete, Myka, and Charlotte must track down Sutton, the only man who knows where they can find Paracelsus and exchange the Philosopher's Stone for the stele that will free Claudia from her bronze imprisonment... before she disintegrates.

20.o: Pete and Myka capture Paracelsus but not before he makes himself immortal. When Myka's cancer becomes worse, Pete must make a deal with Paracelsus to cure his partner. Meanwhile, Claudia receives some startling news from Artie.

1.o: When Paracelsus takes control of Warehouse 13, it proves to only be the first step in his plan to recreate the entire world in his image. To stop him, Pete and Myka must follow him back through time to 1541 and prevent him from killing the Regents and becoming the permanent master of the Warehouses.

2.o: While Pete and Myka team up with two former Secret Service co-workers to investigate a series of bizarre deaths in Washington DC, Artie agrees to show Claudia how and why her sister had to disappear.

3.o: While Pete and Steven check out a life-threatening incident at a renaissance faire, Myka agrees to help Claudia revive her comatose sister. However, they discover that doing so has unexpected consequences that threaten the warehouse and everyone in it.

4.o: Pete's former girlfriend Kelly Hernandez asks him to help her find her missing grandmother, and the trail leads into a cancelled telenovela. Meanwhile, Artie forces Claudia to go with Steve to investigate the case of a college student of whose spine broke in the middle of a classroom presentation.

5.o: The alternate-timeline Valda makes his move, using Claire as his mindless slave. As Valda sets out to move Warehouse 13 to a new location that he can control, the team races desperately to stop him before it's too late.

6.o: While the team deals with the news that Warehouse 13 is moving, Mrs. Frederic has them load their greatest memories of their missions into an artifact for future generations.

1.o: يصل المارشال السابق سيث بولوك إلى ديدوود مع شريكه سول ستار لبدء تجارة جديدة، لكنه سرعان ما يدخل في صراع مع آل سويرينغن، صاحب صالون «جِم».

2.o: بعد المجزرة التي تعرضت لها عائلة في الطريق، تزداد الشكوك حول هوية المسؤول الحقيقي، بينما يحاول سويرينغن حماية الناجية الوحيدة، وهي فتاة صغيرة.

3.o: يصل منافس جديد إلى ديدوود مع افتتاح صالون «بيلا يونيون»، فيبدأ صراع نفوذ مع سويرينغن، بينما يحاول بولوك وستار تأمين أرض لمشروعهما.

4.o: يحاول سويرينغن استعادة مطالبة آل غاريت بالذهب، بينما تلجأ ألما إلى وايلد بيل هيكوك وكالاميتي جين طلبًا للمساعدة.

5.o: تتحول صالة «جِم» إلى محكمة مؤقتة لمحاكمة جاك مكال بعد قتله وايلد بيل هيكوك، فيما تحاول ألما التعامل مع تبعات إدمانها.

6.o: ينتشر وباء في ديدوود، ويواجه بولوك مقاومة أثناء محاولته ملاحقة قاتل هيكوك، بينما يسعى سكان البلدة للحصول على لقاح لإنقاذ المصابين.

7.o: يعود بولوك إلى ديدوود بعد ملاحقة القاتل، وقد تغيرت نظرته للبلدة، بينما يجد نفسه أمام تهديد جديد بسبب تصرفاته.

8.o: تهدأ مخاوف البلدة بعد وصول اللقاح، بينما يثير احتمال عقد معاهدة مع قبيلة السيوكس آمالًا جديدة ويواصل سكان ديدوود صراعاتهم على النفوذ.

9.o: مع اقتراب ضم ديدوود إلى الأراضي المنظمة، يدعو سويرينغن إلى اجتماع بهدف إنشاء حكومة غير رسمية للبلدة وحماية مصالح أصحاب النفوذ.

10.o: تؤدي سرقة شحنة من الأفيون إلى مواجهة سويرينغن مع مورّده، بينما يحاول بولوك التعامل مع تبعات موقفه السياسي وتبدأ ملامح تنظيم البلدة بالظهور.

11.t: Jewel's Boot Is Made for Walking
11.o: يصل والد ألما من نيويورك مدعيًا أنه جاء لمساعدتها، بينما يعقد سويرينغن صفقة مع سايلس آدامز، ويغضب بولوك من تعيين شريف جديد للبلدة.

12.o: تصل قوات الجيش الأمريكي إلى ديدوود بقيادة الجنرال كروك، بينما تتصاعد التوترات حول ألما ومصالح والدها، ويتضح موقع كل شخصية في الصراع على مستقبل البلدة.

1.o: تتصاعد التوترات في ديدوود، وينتهي الخلاف بين سيث بولوك وآل سويرينغن بمواجهة عنيفة، بينما تصل شخصيات جديدة إلى البلدة.

2.o: يواجه بولوك قرارًا حاسمًا بشأن مستقبله وعلاقته بألما، بينما يستعد سويرينغن لمواجهة جديدة، وتعود كالميتي جين إلى البلدة.

3.o: يصل ممثل عن شركة تعدين قوية إلى ديدوود، مهددًا بتغيير موازين القوى، بينما تتدهور صحة سويرينغن ويبحث فارنوم عن مشترٍ لرسالة وايلد بيل هيكوك.

4.o: تتدهور حالة سويرينغن الصحية، ويحاول الطبيب كوكران إجراء عملية قد تنقذ حياته، بينما يحاول بولوك التأقلم مع حياته العائلية الجديدة.

5.o: يواجه سكان ديدوود تهديدًا يطال مطالبات الذهب، بينما يستغل البعض حالة الفوضى لتحقيق مصالحهم، وتجد ألما نفسها في مأزق جديد.

6.o: يشن وولكوت موجة قتل دموية، بينما يتصاعد التوتر بين بولوك وسول ستار ويصبح الصراع على النفوذ أكثر خطورة.

7.o: يكوّن وولكوت أعداءً جددًا داخل البلدة، فيجتمع أصحاب النفوذ لمواجهة تهديده، بينما تحاول ألما تحديد ما إذا كان بإمكانها الوثوق بسويرينغن.

8.o: يواصل وولكوت سعيه للسيطرة على ثروة ديدوود، لكن سويرينغن يضع خطته الخاصة، بينما تتلقى ألما عرضًا مفاجئًا.

9.o: يقدم سويرينغن عرضًا على الآنسة إسرينغهاوزن، بينما يتولى بولوك مسؤولية مبلغ مالي ضخم، وتزداد الشكوك حول إمكانية حماية مصالح البلدة.

10.o: تصاب البلدة بالصدمة بعد حادث مأساوي يتعرض له ويليام بولوك، فتظهر مشاعر الحزن والذنب لدى سكان ديدوود.

11.o: يخيّم الحزن على البلدة، لكن سويرينغن يواصل التخطيط لمصالحه، بينما تتخذ ألما قرارًا مهمًا بشأن علاقتها بإلزوورث.

12.o: تتصاعد الصراعات السياسية والشخصية داخل ديدوود، بينما تتجه الأحداث نحو مواجهة حاسمة تشمل زواجًا مدبرًا وجريمة قتل وإعدامًا.

1.t: Tell Your God to Ready for Blood
1.o: تقترب أول انتخابات حقيقية في ديدوود، بينما يزداد نفوذ هيرست ويصطدم بطموحات بولوك وسويرينغن. وفي الوقت نفسه، تتعرض ألما لمضاعفات في حملها.

2.t: I Am Not the Man You Take Me For
2.ar: لست الرجل الصالح الذي تظنني إياه
2.o: يواصل هيرست استعراض قوته وإرسال رسائل تهديده إلى سويرينغن، بينما تتدهور حالة ألما الصحية ويبدأ القلق بشأن مستقبل صوفيا.

3.o: يصل جاك لانغريش إلى ديدوود مع فرقته المسرحية، بينما تحاول ألما التفاوض مع هيرست بشأن مطالبتها بالذهب، ويكتشف بولوك حقيقة عمليات القتل في صالون «جِم».

4.o: تفتتح ألما أول بنك في ديدوود، بينما يحاول هيرست عقد صفقة مع سويرينغن وتوليفر، ويتعامل بولوك مع عودة الحصان المرتبط بمقتل ابنه.

5.o: تتعرض ألما لانتكاسة بسبب إدمانها، بينما يحاول سويرينغن فهم مخططات هيرست، ويتصاعد الصراع حول الإسطبل بين هوستيتلر وستيف.

6.o: يصل ابن لو المفقود، أوديل، إلى ديدوود، بينما يفكر بولوك وسويرينغن في توجيه ضربة استباقية لهيرست، وتصبح ألما أكثر عرضة لضغوطه.

7.o: يقدم أوديل عرضًا لهيرست يتعلق بالذهب، فيزداد قلق والدته على سلامته. وفي المقابل، يجتمع قادة البلدة لوضع استراتيجية لمواجهة نفوذ هيرست.

8.o: تُنشر رسالة بولوك في صحيفة «ذا بايونير»، مما يثير مخاوف من رد هيرست. وفي الوقت نفسه يصل وايت إيرب وشقيقه إلى ديدوود وسط شكوك حول قصتهما.

9.o: تمتلئ ديدوود برجال هيرست، فيضع بولوك خططًا احتياطية لحماية البلدة، بينما تتزايد الضغوط على سويرينغن وتوليفر وألما.

10.o: يستغل هيرست غياب بولوك لاستهداف ألما، فتجد ملجأً لدى سويرينغن، الذي يحاول انتزاع معلومات عن خطط هيرست من رجاله.

11.o: يواصل هيرست الضغط على ألما بمحاولة جديدة أكثر خطورة، فتعود إلى الاحتماء في صالون سويرينغن، بينما تقرر تريكسي التصرف بنفسها ضد هيرست.

12.o: يتوجه سكان ديدوود إلى صناديق الاقتراع، لكن يبدو أن نتيجة الانتخابات حُسمت مسبقًا. وفي ظل شروط هيرست للرحيل، يستعد سويرينغن لمواجهة أخيرة وحاسمة.

1.o: Derin and Ali are two people from different worlds. Derin is the daughter of a rich man, on the otherside Ali is a 24 years old boy who saw his mom being killed by his dad when he was young. So rauf anne took him as his son and now after many years he is back to istanbul , where he will meet derin and they start to enjoy time with each other.

مسلسل أردني تعليمي وتربوي للأطفال، حيث اشتمل على فقرات تعليمية في مختلف الموضوعات، وعرضت باسلوب مشوق بحيث ترسخ في ذهن الطفل عبر التمثيل المشوق والكوميدي أحيانا،ومن أمثلة فقرات البرنامج مطبخ فرحان وأيضا مغامرات أبي الحروف وكذلك الفريق السري وأيضا زيد وعمرو وغيرها من فقرات متنوعة.
Eun Bong-Hee seeks revenge on her cheating boyfriend, but her knight in shining armor turns out to be Noh Ji-Wook, a prosecutor she earlier accused of being a pervert.

2.o: Bong-Hee secures herself a legal internship, unaware that her instructor will be Ji-Wook, who remembers her antics well.

3.o: The tables are turned when Bong-Hee suddenly finds herself accused of murder. The situation only worsens when Ji-Wook is made the case's prosecutor, his future dependent on her confession.

4.o: Ji-Wook finds a bloody knife at the scene of the crime that could greatly affect the case. Bong-Hee's murder trial begins.

5.o: Bong-Hee tries to find Hee-Joon's real murderer, but her only hint is a melody. Ji-Wook has trouble adjusting to no longer being a prosecutor.

6.o: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook take on opposing clients, but they realize they must work together when things go awry.

7.o: Bong-Hee has a close encounter with the culprit. Ji-Wook notices District Attorney Jang keeping an eye on Bong-Hee.

8.o: Bong-Hee searches for work while living at Ji-Wook’s house. Ji-Wook’s ex, Yoo-Jung, comes back to town with a mission in her mind.

9.o: Bong-Hee pretends to be Ji-Wook's girlfriend in front of Yoo-Jung. Ji-Wook hands in his resignation letter.

10.o: Ji-Wook sets up his own law firm and begins recruiting employees. Lawyer Ji’s backstory with Ji-Wook is revealed.

11.o: Ji-Wook quickly becomes frustrated with his newly-assembled team. The suspect of a murder and robbery case requests Bong-Hee as his lawyer.

12.o: Bong-Hee has a dangerous confrontation with District Attorney Jang. Jung Hyun-Soo’s lack of an alibi creates difficulty for Ji-Wook’s team.

13.o: Bong-Hee struggles to reset her feelings for Ji-Wook after being denied. Details of a past assault case arise concerning Jung Hyun-Soo.

14.o: Ji-Wook faces off with unreliable witnesses in the courtroom. Later, he answers a call that could change everything.

15.o: Ji-Wook tries to find out more about Hyun-Soo while keeping his team in the dark. Lawyer Ji's excitement for a special day is quickly dampened.

16.o: Hyun-Soo begins to catch on to Ji-Wook's suspicions. Bong-Hee has trouble moving on from Ji-Wook when he can't seem to leave her alone.

17.o: Go Chan-Ho resorts to desperate measures to get away from Hyun-Soo. Ji-Wook comes to terms with his feelings, but is he too late?

18.o: Bong-Hee decides to help lawyer Byun out with his "heroic" DUI case. District Attorney Jang asks Yoo-Jung and Ji-Hye to help him reinvestigate Hee-Joon's murder.

19.o: Lawyer Ji receives a strange request from a client and is faced with a dilemma he can't consult his team on.

20.o: Bong-Hee becomes determined to figure out the Park Sung-Eun case, even if she has to forgo bathing. Ji-Wook tells Bong-Hee about his family’s past.

21.o: Ji-Wook takes on a seemingly psychic client who has a vision that could affect more than just his case. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook receive a new clue regarding Hee-Joon’s murder.

22.o: A frightening realization comes crashing down on Bong-Hee. So Jung-Ha's predictions freak out the firm.

23.o: Bong-Hee’s old friend calls her for help after she’s attacked. Ji-Wook’s firm wants to continue investigating Jung Hyun-Soo, but they need help.

24.o: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook search for a witness or a weapon from Yeon-Woo's attack. Social media-savvy Lawyer Ji then takes things into his own hands.

25.o: Chief Bang is rushed to the hospital, his fate unknown. Tensions rise at the firm as Ji-Wook begins thinking about revenge.

26.o: The firm contemplates if fabricating evidence is their only option for having Hyun-Soo arrested.

27.o: Hyun-Soo is admitted to the hospital while still unconscious, therefore putting his arrest on hold. Ji-Wook wonders who could have planted the bloody knife.

28.o: An arson case brings back painful memories of the past. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook go out on an arcade date, but run into unexpected company.

29.o: Ji-Wook is at a loss after seeing the photo on Bong-Hee's nightstand, and he decides to delve deeper into the past.

30.o: Bong-Hee notices Ji-Wook's strange behavior as they investigate the arson case. Eun-Hyuk goes to Yoo-Jung for help.

31.o: Bong-Hee breaks up with Ji-Wook, but is left with nowhere to go. Ji-Wook goes to see District Attorney Jang.

32.o: A child from Bong-Hee's Taekwondo classes witnesses a murder, but claims he doesn't remember the killer's face.

33.o: Hyun-Soo wakes up, but seemingly can't remember anything, which leaves Ji-Wook suspicious.

34.o: The firm looks deeper into Hyun-Soo's past, as he is presented with his own belongings to help jog his memory.

35.o: Hyun-Soo's whereabouts are unknown, and no one knows just how much of his memory has returned.

36.o: Ji-Wook must tell Bong-Hee the truth about their parents' deaths. District Attorney Jang re-examines his son's murder case.

37.o: District Attorney Jang and Hyun-Soo disappear together. Ji-Wook and Bong-Hee search for them, afraid of what might happen.

38.o: Hyun-Soo's trial begins, but Ji-Wook doesn't plan to charge him with murder. Instead, he comes up with a new plan.

39.o: Bong-Hee worries about all that could go wrong if she gets back together with Ji-Wook. Hyun-Soo's final trial arrives.

40.o: A new case causes conflict between Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook as they learn more about how to love each other.

1.o: In 1988 Seoul, Deok-sun spends her days hanging out with childhood friends and practicing her role in the upcoming Olympics opening ceremony.

2.t: One Thing You Misunderstood About Me
2.o: Choi Taek's latest win calls for a neighborhood celebration. Deok-sun and Dong-il grieve for their loved one's passing in different ways.

3.t: The Rich are Innocent, and the Poor are Guilty
3.o: Despite her disastrous dance skills, Deok-sun is determined to win a cassette player at a talent show being held during her school retreat.

4.o: Deok-sun declares she wants to get into college, Seong-gyun nurses hurt feelings, and Taek deals poorly with losing.

5.o: Bo-ra's participation in risky student protests upsets Dong-il. Sun-young wants to show her mother she's doing all right, even when she isn't.

6.o: Taek shoulders heavy pressure as he heads to China for a tournament. Deok-sun writes about experiencing first love, which Jung-hwan happens to read.

7.o: With Christmas around the corner, everyone picks names for Secret Santa. Jung-hwan notices Deok-sun wants a pair of pink mittens.

8.o: While the Kim family braces for Jung-bong's heart surgery, Bo-ra runs into relationship trouble, and Deok-sun meets No-eul's girlfriend.

9.t: What it Means to Cross the Line
9.o: The new year comes with money trouble for Sun-young and a health scare for Moo-sung. Deok-sun gets a glimpse of Taek's life in the spotlight.

10.o: Everyone piles into Bo-ra's car to fetch Dong-ryong after he runs away from home on his birthday. Deok-sun and Taek take a detour on the way back.

11.o: The moms see a fortuneteller. Jung-hwan grapples with complicated feelings, made worse when Deok-sun and her family temporarily move into his house.

12.t: What It Means To Love Someone
12.o: Secrets abound as Sun-young keeps news about her part-time job from Sun-woo, who sneaks around with Bo-ra. Moo-sung babysits.

13.o: Il-hwa gets anxious about a lump on her chest before a physical at the hospital. Taek leaves for a big competition in Tokyo.

14.o: Sun-woo doesn't like that Sun-young and Moo-sung have grown so close. Deok-sun gifts Jung-hwan a pink shirt for his birthday.

15.o: Deok-sun faces a harsh reality check about getting into college. Dong-ryong ends up at the police station. Seong-gyun takes a bad fall.

16.o: When a TV singing competition rolls into town, Mi-ran and Dong-ryong are eager to audition. Bo-ra moves out to study for the bar exam.

17.o: As Deok-sun and the boys ponder their futures, the parents discuss their own bygone dreams. Meanwhile, Taek dreams of something sweeter.

18.o: It's 1994, and the friends are back in town for Taek's birthday. Deok-sun gets stood up for a concert, and Bo-ra agrees to a blind date.

19.o: During a layover in Beijing, Deok-sun makes sure to stop by to take care of Taek. Jung-hwan puts together a touching surprise for Mi-ran.

20.o: While Sun-woo and Bo-ra set out to change their parents' minds about their relationship, juicy gossip about Taek turns up on the news.

1.o: الحصول على وظيفة دائمة ليس بالأمر السهل بالنسبة للشباب الكوريين الذين ليس لديهم معارف أو أموال، مثل "سانغ سو" - أو للنساء، مثل "جيونغ او".

2.o: يتجاهل الضابط "اوه يانغ تشون" مكالمة من زوجته حول حالة أسرية طارئة من أجل مساعدة زميل برتبة أعلى في مطاردة أحد المشتبه بهم.

3.o: يتفاجأ الشرطيان تحت التجربة بمدى دموية أول مسرح جريمة يشهدانه، ويعثر "يانغ تشون" على دليل براءته.

4.o: يبدو أن "يانغ تشون" يأبى الانسجام مع أي شخص، لا سيما "سانغ سو"، في حين تستجيب "جيونغ او" لبلاغ بشأن حادثة عنف أسري.

5.o: بدءًا بالقضايا الصعبة فالتوترات في مكان العمل ووصولًا إلى الشؤون الشخصيّة، فإن كلّ يوم لضباط قسم دوريّات "هونغيل" هو يوم مثقل بالمشاكل.

6.o: يُلقي الذعر بظلاله على قسم دوريّات "هونغيل" بعد حادثة "جيونغ او"، التي تواجه تحقيقًا من قسم الشؤون الداخليّة هي ومُرشدها "كانغ نام إيل".

7.o: تفشل محاولة "جيونغ او" في القبض على مشتبه به في قضية دعارة، ويزداد السخط على "يانغ تشون" بعد إصابة "سانغ سو" خلال العمل.

8.o: تتضافر جهود "جانغ مي" و"جيونغ او" و"نام إيل" للقبض على المتورطين في الدّعارة، وتتصاعد روح المنافسة في قسم دوريّات "هونغيل" خلال نشاط ترويحي.

9.o: يفصح "سانغ سو" عن مشاعره تجاه "جيونغ او" وهو أكثر يأسًا من أي وقت مضى، كما تتعاون "جانغ مي" و"غيونغ مو" للتحقيق في صفقات "جو يونغ" المشبوهة.

10.o: مثلما تنبّأ "هان سول"، يفقد "يانغ تشون" صوابه عندما يعلم بما كان يفعله "جو يونغ"، وتزداد صدمته عندما يسمع ما فعله والده.

11.o: يعقد الضبّاط العزم على تحقيق العدالة لـ"سام بو"، كما أنّ "جانغ مي" متيقّنة من أن المغتصب المتسلسل طليق، لكنها تفتقر إلى دليل لتطلب فريق عمل.

12.o: تصيب أزمة أخرى ضحية الاعتداء الجنسي الأخير... أمّا "يانغ تشون" فينضمّ إلى فريق "جانغ مي" مُستهدفين القبض على مرتكب الجرائم الجنسية المتسلسل.

13.o: على الرغم من المخاطر، يُطارد "سانغ سو" المشتبه فيه في الغابة. أما "هان سول" فيُبقي تشخيص مرضه سرًّا مع اقتراب موعد زواج ابنته.

14.o: تخاطر "جيونغ او" بمواجهة الشؤون الداخلية مجددًا من خلال الجدل حول التربية الجنسية في المدارس والإساءة إلى أولياء أمور طلاب المدرسة الثانوية.

15.o: تواجه "جانغ مي" إجراءات تأديبيّة مشدّدة بسبب خطأ ارتكبه رؤساؤها، ويُتّهم "مين سيوك" باستخدام قوّة مفرطة في تقييد مواطن.

16.o: تضرّر قسم دوريات "هونغيل" بشدّة من جرّاء الحادث الأخير، ويواصل الضبّاط التعامل مع الوقائع الظالمة التي تشكّك في كونهم ضبّاطًا شرفاء.

17.o: متردّدة في إحساسها بالواجب كشرطيّة دوريّة، تتّخذ "جيونغ او" قرارها الصعب، ولكنّها لا تستطيع مقاومة الشعور بالذنب، وخاصة تجاه "سانغ سو".

18.o: تصبح مسيرة "سانغ سو" المهنية على المحكّ، حيث تُصنّف وسائل الإعلام قضيّته بأنها عنف مسلّح، ويسارع قادة الشرطة إلى استرضاء الرأي العام.

1.o: After Tails gets injured during a battle against Dr. Eggman, Sonic, fearing for his safety, fires him and holds auditions for a new sidekick.

2.t: Can an Evil Genius Crash on Your Couch for a Few Days?
2.o: Dr. Eggman moves in with Sonic and Tails while his fortress is under repairs. While there, he drives Sonic and Tails to the breaking point with his annoying traits.

3.o: Tails builds a translator robot with the unintentional ability to read minds. His friends are not impressed.

4.o: When Sticks' friends tell her to be nicer to (non-anthropomorphic) animals, she becomes attached to a slime-belching robot dog named Buster.

5.o: After being invited to a fancy gala, Sticks admits she does not know how to behave like a lady.

6.o: Amy decides to accept Eggman's invitation to design his lair for a magazine cover.

7.o: Dr. Eggman hires an new intern to help out around the base, unaware of the intern's true desire.

8.o: Dr. Eggman makes evil cookies to turn Sonic into his lackey, but instead, gets all his friends to work with to destroy Sonic.

9.o: Sonic and Tails rescue some villagers from bandits, but can't get away from the village thanks to all the guilt being thrown onto them.

10.o: Cubot and bot wake up with no memory of the last day and no trace of Eggman around anywhere.

11.o: When Tails reprograms one of Dr. Eggman's robots, it becomes a killing machine set on destroying Eggman.

12.o: In hopes of having new additions to his traveling circus, a ringmaster captures Sonic and his friends.

13.o: Knuckles feels that the only reason Sonic always bests him is that Sonic has better luck. So, Knuckles tries to run out his bad luck and reset the luck balance of the universe by constantly putting himself in harm’s way.

14.o: A meteor causes Sonic and Eggman to exchange bodies.

15.o: After losing his confidence, Dr. Eggman gets help from a motivational speaker, and then becomes too reliant on the life coach.

16.t: How to Succeed in Evil Without Really Trying
16.o: When Tails' orchard picking machine runs amok, a group of evil scientists believe Tails is one of them.

17.o: After being injured in a battle against Sonic, Egghead decides to take Sonic to court to receive justice.

18.o: When Dr. Eggman markets his own brand of tomato sauce, the others are suspicious of possible ulterior motives.

19.o: Sonic must give up his speed when it causes a deafening tone, but Dr. Eggman may have a remedy.

21.o: Sonic, Tails and Knuckles wake up a sleeping rock giant who begins rampaging.

22.t: The Curse of Buddy Buddy Temple
22.o: Sonic and Eggman must use teamwork and friendship in order to escape from the ancient temple they are trapped in.

23.o: Orbot and Cubot must defeat a living computer virus in the cyber world.

24.o: Sonic realizes he has 7 minutes to return Amy's library book and ends up racing the clock, as he battles slow senior citizens, burger cravings, and an angry Eggman.

25.o: When Sticks insists on being the one to teach Amy survival skills, Sonic and Knuckles challenge them to a race through the jungle.

26.o: After Sonic and the others use Eggman's technology against him, he swears off technology for good; Lightning Bolt Society unleashes an attack.

27.o: Amy decides to open her own restaurant which causes a rivalry with their former hang out and Dave the Intern.

28.o: A cool new shrew arrives in town, threatening Sonic's status as the town's biggest hero.

29.t: Curse of the Cross Eyed Moose
29.o: After seeing a cross-eyed moose, Sticks is convinced that she and her friends are cursed. They set out to find a mystical marmoset who is the only one who can remove the curse.

30.o: Knuckles wants to win the village's annual Chili Dog Cook-Off and on his quest to find the perfect ingredients he meets the Pepper People, and their leader Claggerhorn who have been waiting for a savior to bring them the freedom they deserve.

31.o: When Amy realizes that Sticks is a pack rat, she forces her friend to have a garage sale to get rid of all the junk that's accumulated in her burrow. During the sale, a secret locked door to an underground world is removed and an invading horde is set free.

32.o: When Knuckles is made mayor for the day, he sends the village into chaos. Sonic and friends, and even Eggman, have to band together to stop him from ruining the village.

33.o: Eggman is making a movie about his life. He even tries to cast Sonic to play a lame version of Sonic. Is this just a bad movie or a merely a diversion for a secret evil plan?

34.o: After Sonic calls Mike "a normal guy", Amy sets up a seminar to help him develop a more sensitive attitude.

35.o: When another Knuckles from an alternative dimension becomes stranded in their world and causes trouble for Sonic and his friends, the gang must figure out a way to get him home.

36.o: When Orbot and Cubot discover a group of rejected Cubot prototypes hiding in the jungle, they seek the help of Sonic and Tails to protect them from Eggman.

37.o: Dave the Intern inadvertently takes down Eggman and becomes a true vilain.

38.o: While the rest of the village is celebrating New Year's Eve, Eggman decides to slow down time in order to complete his previous resolution of defeating Sonic... somehow.

39.o: The guys go undercover as a boy band to prove that Amy and Sticks are being brainwashed by a pop icon.

40.o: Tails is experiencing a crush; Dr. Eggman has a difficult time picking up his package from the post office.

41.o: Sonic and Knuckles enter a best friend game show to win a new couch for Amy, but the show pairs Sonic up with Dr. Eggman.

42.o: When Knuckles replaces Comedy Chimp on the Comedy Chimp show, Comedy Chimp elicits the help of Dr. Eggman to steal back the show. Sonic and the gang must save their friend.

44.t: It Wasn't Me, It Was the One-Armed Hedgehog

45.o: In order to prove that he is an inventor like Tails, Knuckles challenges Tails to enter the local robot battle; little do they know Dr. Eggman has also entered the contest.

46.o: Dr. Eggman is in trouble with his homeowners' association and will stop at nothing to defeat them, even if it means hosting a fancy dinner.

48.o: The gang accepts a dare from Dr. Eggman to fight him not as a group but one at a time. Eggman uses each hero's weakness to his advantage.

49.o: When Sonic and the gang win an award for being role models, it comes with a price that keeps them from doing their jobs as heroes.

51.o: Knuckles tries to make amends for a past misdeed, but he only succeeds at making things worse.

52.t: It Takes a Village to Defeat a Hedgehog
52.o: In his most diabolical plan yet, Dr. Eggman decides to band together with all of Sonic's enemies. Shadow the Hedgehog, joins the fight.

1.o: Sonic lets martial arts action movie star Tommy Thunder follow him around and observe his "hero process" for Tommy's upcoming role. However, things erupt when Tommy's over-the-top ego clashes with Sonic's and he starts to claim credit for the gang's victories.

2.o: Eggman discovers that an asteroid is on a collision course with the planet! It's up to Sonic and his friends to destroy the asteroid.

3.o: Sticks is fed up that all the news is fluff, so with Tails' help, she creates a podcast to speak truth to power. It becomes so popular that the TV news producer decides to fire Soar and replace him with Sticks. But in order to report the truth, Sticks is pressured into toeing the company line.

4.o: Sonic and Tails are working on an invention to make Sonic even faster. Unfortunately, Sonic goes so fast that he eventually disappears. Tails is nervous. Did he disintegrate Sonic? Meanwhile, Sonic is alone in another plane of existence where he can only see ghostly images of his friends but can't communicate with them. When Eggman decides to attack, the gang battles him while protecting Tails so he can work on a solution.

5.o: Sonic is pestered by Mark the Tapir, who weasels his way into a position as Sonic's assistant. Eventually, Mark crosses the line and captures Sonic and his friends.

6.t: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Worse-er
6.o: Eggman challenges Tails to prove he is a genius by capturing Sonic.

7.t: I Can Sea Sonic's Fear From Here

So Eggman concocts a plan to have Sonic fight him underwater. Motivational speaker Soar the Eagle will have to use all his coaching talents to help Sonic overcome his phobia of the water in order to defeat Eggman.

8.o: Sticks discovers Dreamcaster, a mysterious figure trying to hypnotize the village in the middle of the night. The gang doesn't believe Sticks, telling her Dreamcaster isn't real and her paranoia is out of control.

9.o: Tails takes a failure during a battle with Eggman to heart. He feels that even though he's the smart one in the group, he's just not smart enough to help Sonic and the gang. So he creates a machine to duplicate himself and form a "brain trust." But will he and his duplicates be smart enough to defeat anything that Eggman can come up with?

10.o: After a very humiliating defeat at the hands of Sonic and the gang, Eggman returns to his lair and takes out his frustrations on Orbot and Cubot. The robot duo has finally had enough! Down tools! They're going on strike!

11.o: The good people of the Unnamed Village feel that things have gotten pretty lawless. They figure there's not a lot they can do to stop evil, so they license, regulate, and tax it. Eggman fails the evil test and must wait 90 days to do evil, so Eggman decides to use Orbot as his front. Orbot will get an evil license and Eggman will be the puppet master. But Orbot's ego gets out of control and Eggman must get Sonic's help to defeat The Evil Dr. Orbot.

12.o: During a fight against Eggman, Knuckles suffers amnesia. His friends try to help, reminding him of his worst blunders via flashbacks. But he becomes more depressed when he learns that he is the last of his kind - the final echidna. Feeling all alone in the world, Knuckles sets out to find a foster family among the Villagers who might be willing to take him in.

13.o: Sonic stumbles upon an ancient mech suit. It makes him more powerful, but soon Sonic becomes dependent on it, and it starts to change his personality.

14.o: Eggman builds a giant new robot to defeat Sonic. He programs it to know everything about the Blue Blur, but things don't go as planned - with all FiendBot's knowledge of Sonic, it doesn't want to destroy him, it wants to be his friend.

15.o: The gang becomes suspicious when Froglodyte Og comes to the surface world. They fear their suspicions may be correct when a Froglodyte army arrives in The Village.

21.o: Feeling the need for unconditional love, Eggman creates "Mombot"... but she's overly critical and embarrasses him in front of Sonic.

22.o: Tails sets out on a course to prove that Muckfoot, a mythical creature, is real.

29.o: Hypno-bot teams up with Eggman to conquer the world, so Team Sonic teams up with their cyborg duplicates to defeat Hypno-bot and his army.

30.o: Despite Eggman attacking with his tiniest robot yet, it poses a problem to the gang and to the village.

1.o: Freeman travels around the world in search of a greater understanding of the concept of freedom. From solitary confinement and forced labor camps, to social taboos and laws that hinder speech and expression, freedom seems to be a constant struggle. As individuals and as entire nations, we are confronted with the question: Will we all ever be truly free?

2.o: Freeman travels the world to study the cycles of war and peace. From the ritualized combat of the sacred Tinku festival in Bolivia to Rwanda’s postgenocide reconciliation program, this episode deals with humanity’s enormous capacity for violence and the endless pursuit of harmony. Conflict can drive innovation, but is war necessary? Physical barriers and a fear of destruction might make us more cautious, but is peace merely the absence of war?

3.o: Can love change the world? Freeman is on a global quest to understand how this primal force binds us together as a species. From orphanages to battlefields, from arranged marriages to life on the streets, Freeman sees how love can be found in unexpected places – and how this force inspires us all.

4.o: Can we bridge the divide between “us and them?” At a time when the whole world seems to be polarizing into irreconcilable camps, Freeman sets out on a journey in search of the forces that push us apart, from intolerance of differences to fear of outsiders, and the possibilities of coming together.

5.o: Can we find a way to distribute power so that everyone has their say? A U.S. president explains the challenges of making decisions that affect hundreds of millions of lives, and Freeman learns about an African woman who has created a society without men. He explores how the rise of the internet may fundamentally change how democracy works.

6.o: Freeman’s quest to understand what makes a rebellion successful brings him face-to-face with exiles, whistleblowers, hackers and movement leaders. From Berlin to Bolivia to the United States, he’ll see the courage, dedication, hard work and hope that it takes to try to change the world.

1.o: After Earth is rendered uninhabitable, Androids Mother and Father start a new settlement and family with human embryos on the planet Kepler-22b. Twelve years later, only one child, Campion, remains, and the arrival of an Ark of surviving humans called the Mithraic presents a threat that Mother has no choice but to confront.

2.o: After a confrontation with Marcus, Mother discovers and takes five Mithraic children (Hunter, Tempest, Paul, Holly and Vita) back to her settlement. While Mother, Father and Campion, adjust to living with a new group of Earth-born children, Marcus struggles to survive alone on Kepler-22b.

3.o: After the Mithraic kids fall sick, Campion believes Mother is poisoning them and plans an escape. As Mother and Father attempt to prove otherwise, Marcus and Sue work to convince the other surviving Mithraic to mount a rescue of the children, desperate to get their son Paul back.

4.o: Father tries to teach the children how to hunt some of Kepler-22b’s mysterious creatures for food. Meanwhile, the Mithraic make a stunning discovery that potentially fulfills a Mithraic prophecy, and a debate about how to proceed ignites a conflict between Marcus and the Mithraic leader, Ambrose.

5.o: Marcus moves forward with a plan to rescue the Mithraic children, but first he has to find them. Back at the settlement, Campion and Paul bond while on a hunting expedition with Father, and Mother attempts to learn more about her origins.

7.o: Marcus’s decisions stress his relationship to his family as he struggles to maintain his clout as leader of the Mithraic. Mother is able to see Marcus for who he truly is, which threatens his power and puts Mother in a precarious situation she might not recover from. Meanwhile, Campion is faced with a choice that could result in dire consequences.

10.o: Paul begins displaying troubling behavior not unlike that of Marcus, leading to a shocking discovery. Father struggles with human-like emotions. Mother and Father discover a startling secret about the planet they’re on, just as a new threat arrives on Kepler-22b.

7.o: Jacky finds himself working for the CIA and French secret service, who both insist on him wearing a wire to a meeting organised by Colonel Amanullah at his palace, but will he crack under pressure?

9.o: Under increasing pressure from the CIA, Jacky finds himself in need of a quick getaway, but escaping without a passport is tricky. Paul Braque has the right contacts, but wants something in return...

10.o: The CIA threaten Jacky with a one-way ticket to Guantanamo if he doesn't help with their investigation. Jacky must retrieve the murder weapon, an ivory-handled gun, but it's easier said than done.

Amanullah gathers his children to announce his great project: he will be the next president of Afghanistan! Lala collapsed. Axel meets Jamal, the colonel's disabled son and the naughty duckling of the brood.

Damien learns that Sophie is pregnant, which doesn't really please him as he embarks on his new business: an extreme bus for thrill-seeking tourists. To please Sophie, Damien agreed to let Lala accompany her on her excursions; but Lala secretly uses her expat bus to pass the roadblocks and ferry her weapons.

6.o: The NGO "The Bamboo's Solution", supported by Angelina Jolie, is likely to win grants at the expense of the rose programme. Michel uses all his talents to convince the representative of the European Commission to support the roses, in vain. The Russian mobsters lend a hand to Michel: they eliminate the European official. Lala's arms trade is uncovered. Damien understands that he was fooled. Jamal, the unloved son of the Amanullah clan, takes power. The colonel is thrown out into the street.

7.o: Amanullah is invited to give a speech at the UN. Since burning his opium in front of the cameras, the repentant drug trafficker has been a star. Problem: Amanullah has been depressed at Kabul Kitchen since he was kicked out of his palace by his son. Habib, pushed by Michel who sees it as a possible source of income, joins the cast of the "Afghan Star", the "New Star" Afghan version. There he meets Pissenlit, an attractive competitor. It's love at first sight. Problem: The girl's father is a fearsome warlord.

8.o: Amanullah leaves Kabul, covered in shame after crying in front of the world's cameras at the UN. He takes refuge in the Mountains of Logar, at the home of Monadjat, a "war lady", a long-time friend. Axel, against Lala's advice, decides to adopt Aklamash, a 12-year-old orphan who has been following him everywhere since they met. As for Michel, he was arrested by the anti-drug squad which forced him to work together to bring down Jamal's business. For Michel, it's an opportunity to get rid of the Russians by making them take the blame.

9.o: Amanullah discovers that his son Jamal is about to sell his drug to Russians. That's one too many for the colonel. He takes Michel on board to storm the heroin convoy and destroy it. Damien decided to leave Kabul without telling Sophie, who is due to give birth shortly. But on the way to the airport, Axel needs him: Lala is in danger. They all end up at the place of the deal with the Russians. But they don't know that Michel has made a deal with the police, and nothing goes according to plan... Meanwhile, Habib, threatened by Pissenlit's father, flees with his dulcinea.

10.o: The Russians force Sophie to hand Michel over to them against Damien's release. Amanullah and Lala, deprived of the army, steal a stockpile of weapons and a mysterious safe. Victor finds himself with an international arrest warrant on his back; Jamal's heroin trafficking fell on him. Amanullah learns that Sophie and Michel are in mortal danger. The whole little "family" of Kabul Kitchen board Damien's bus to fly to their rescue.

11.o: The stolen safe contains a large amount of enriched liquid uranium. If they want to sell this precious cargo and pocket $100 million, they have to go to Kandahar. The epic continues towards the mountains. So here they are not only pursued by the Russians who want Michel back, but also by Yazad who wants his safe back, and by Pissenlit's father who wants his daughter back. Suddenly, Sophie has her first contractions... The bus must stop again.

12.o: Sophie gives birth, with the help of Michel. But the Russians caught up with the bus. Michel, the one responsible for all their problems, sacrifices himself. The Russians are recovering the uranium and Michel. The latter owes his salvation to providence... and his talent. Back in Kabul, nothing will be the way it used to be: Sophie realizes that Afghanistan is not a country to raise a child, she leaves Kabul with her daughter.
